Quiz Show Kit

Start with the real BioVista quiz. Change the event, teams, colours, questions and rules in one configuration. The finished quiz is one offline HTML file. Everything here runs locally in your browser; no account or API key is needed.

Play the original BioVista example · Copy the ChatGPT handoff · Configuration guide

How to customize

Edit event.title, both team names and colours, theme colours, rules and questions below. Retain internal team IDs Bio/Vista. For a new theme, replace the BioVista artwork with your approved assets and use theme.motif: none to hide DNA. Ask ChatGPT to prepare the configuration using the linked handoff. Imported file assets must be added here using matching filenames; existing built-in artwork is already embedded.
